title: Rare/less common: spontaneous coronary artery dissection (SCAD)

symptoms: Acute chest pain after intense emotional stress; discomfort persists for 30 minutes.
No known prior coronary disease. Scenario includes a recent major stressor; it is a clue, not proof of SCAD.
history: Pregnancy/postpartum history must be asked when relevant, not assumed
presentation.vitals: HR 92 bpm; BP 118/74 mmHg; RR 18/min; SpO2 98%; stable at initial snapshot.
presentation.initial_ecg_summary: T-wave inversion and subtle ST changes in anterior leads; no definitive pattern at first reading.
presentation.initial_troponin_summary: Serial hs-cTn rises above fictional assay threshold; CBC, renal function and electrolytes without major simulated abnormality.
presentation.notice: Synthetic educational scenario only; pending clinical review. Simulation tier is not a validated clinical risk score.
